python -c "
import semver

# Test replace function
print('Testing module-level replace:')
result = semver.replace('3.4.5', major=4, minor=5)
print(f'  replace(\"3.4.5\", major=4, minor=5) = {repr(result)}')

result = semver.replace('3.4.5-pre.2+build.4', prerelease='alpha.1')
print(f'  replace(\"3.4.5-pre.2+build.4\", prerelease=\"alpha.1\") = {repr(result)}')

# Test VersionInfo.replace method
print('\nTesting VersionInfo.replace:')
v = semver.VersionInfo(3, 4, 5)
new_v = v.replace(major=4, minor=5)
print(f'  VersionInfo(3,4,5).replace(major=4, minor=5) = {repr(new_v)}')

v2 = semver.VersionInfo.parse('3.4.5-pre.2+build.4')
new_v2 = v2.replace(prerelease='alpha.1')
print(f'  parse(\"3.4.5-pre.2+build.4\").replace(prerelease=\"alpha.1\") = {repr(new_v2)}')

# Check immutability - original should be unchanged
print(f'  Original v after replace: {repr(v)}')
print(f'  Original v2 after replace: {repr(v2)}')

# Test public names
print('\nTesting public names:')
print(f'  createparser: {semver.createparser}')
print(f'  main: {semver.main}')
print(f'  process: {semver.process}')

# Test process function
v3 = semver.process('3.4.5-pre.2+build.4')
print(f'  process(\"3.4.5-pre.2+build.4\"): {repr(v3)}')

# Test createparser
parser = semver.createparser()
print(f'  createparser(): {parser}')
"
